_help: One object per event, in any order. Required: date (YYYY-MM-DD) and title. Optional: time (HH:MM), end_date, venue, city, with (other speakers), description, url (link to the event page), link_label. title, venue, with and description can be plain text (shown in both languages) or {"en": "...", "it": "..."}. The site sorts events and moves them from 'Upcoming' to 'Past' by itself.
